title: Nnome a Ɛfa Otwa Bebree Ho
intro: Wɔ tete asase bi so no, na ɔkra pɔtee bi gyina wɔn mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔwɔ sika sen biara no ho. Na asase so nhyira aba wɔn so mprenu wɔ mfe a ɛtoatoa so mu, otwa mmɔho abien a anka ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde aseda hyɛ wɔn koma ma. Nanso bere a awerɛhosɛm sii na wɔfaa biribiara a wɔwɔ anadwo biako no, wɔn mmuae no daa sɛnea wɔn kra te ankasa adi. So wobɛtumi ada onipa ko a saa onipa yi a n’asɛm yɛ kɔkɔbɔ a ɛtia Allah nhyira a wɔnnye nni no adi?
clues: Na meka akra a wɔwɔ anigye sen biara wɔ asase no so nyinaa ho, a wɔde nnuan pii ahyira wɔn.
Otwa adwuma no baa me so mprenu wɔ mfe abien mu, nanso m’akoma kɔɔ so yɛɛ nea ɛnkyerɛ m’Awurade.
Na mewɔ turo kɛseɛ bi a bobe, ngodua, ne mmɛdua wɔ mu —adanseɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ Allah adom.
Bere a wɔsɛee me turo no, migyinaa n’amamfõ mu a meteɛ nsa akɔ soro, domee me nkrabea.
Mepoo sɛ anka Allah betumi ama adehwere a ɛte saa aba, mpo sɛ mede abasamtu bubuu me nsateaa.
Na m’asotwe nyɛ me turo a mehweree ara kwa, na mmom sɛ wogyaw me a mintumi nyɛ hwee koraa wɔ n’amamfõ mu, a mantumi amfrɛ ɔboafo biara.
